summary: Expand Ψ by finite Fourier inversion on (𝓞_E/𝔪)^n into characters b ↦ ψ_𝔪(·b); the name of a character applied to u is a root of unity times a finite Heisenberg translate of P^𝔪u = v. So Ψ⊗u is a two-layer combination: outer coefficients Ψ(a) (integral away from q, size ≤ B) and inner coefficients |𝓞_E/𝔪|^{−n} times roots of unity, which N(g)^n makes integral away from q.

steps.claim: Replace Ψ by its Fourier expansion Ψ = ∑_a Ψ(a)·|R^n|⁻¹·∑_b ψ_𝔪(−a·b)·ψ_𝔪(·b), R = 𝓞_E/𝔪, ψ_𝔪 the primitive additive character of R (`Modulus.primAddChar`); the identity is proved in step 6.
steps.lean:
rw [← (_ : ∑ a, Ψ a • ∑ b,
    (card (n → 𝔪.ResRing) : ℂ)⁻¹ • 𝔪.primAddChar (-a ⬝ᵥ b) • (𝔪.primAddChar <| · ⬝ᵥ b) = Ψ)]

steps.claim: By linearity of the name and of the lift, Ψ⊗u = ∑_a Ψ(a)·∑_b |R^n|⁻¹ψ_𝔪(−a·b)·name(liftFn ψ_𝔪(·b))(u).

The two layers are admissible and compose (`IsAdmissibleComb.bind`): the outer coefficients Ψ(a) are integral away from q and of total size ≤ B when p holds (hΨ, hB); each inner term |R^n|⁻¹ψ_𝔪(−a·b)·name(ψ_𝔪(·b))(u) is a root of unity times |R^n|⁻¹ times finHeisOp(z)(v) for a lift z of b (`name_char_eq_translate_projOn` and P^𝔪u = v), and N(g)^n·|R^n|⁻¹ is integral away from q because |R| = N(𝔪) divides N(g·q) (g·q ∈ 𝔪). It remains that the lift z is admissible.

    .of_eq_isOfFinOrder_smul (.of_sum (fun _ _ ↦
    div_mem_integralAway (by simpa [natAbs_mul, Algebra.norm_natCast, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, absNorm,
    Submodule.cardQuot_apply] using (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd (natCast_dvd.1 (absNorm_dvd_norm_of_mem hg))
    _))) (by simp)) (𝔪.reduction_surjective.comp_left.forall.2 fun z _ ↦ ⟨_, isOfFinOrder_ψf _, _,
    fun i w h ↦ ?_, by erw [← (𝔪.reduction_surjective (-_)).choose_spec, primAddChar_reduction,
    smul_smul, ← (stdLattice.psi₀ E).3, sub_add_cancel, name_char_eq_translate_projOn, hv]; rfl⟩)

steps.claim: For a place w not dividing q, w-integrality of d̄·z_i: d·z_i is integral at w since d·q ∈ 𝔪 makes d times the generator of 𝔪 integral and q is a unit at w; conjugation preserves integrality.

    mem_Ô.1 (star_mem_Ô (mul_mem (by simpa [↓generator_spec] using d.2) (z i).2)) w

steps.claim: Hence d̄·z_i is integral at w.
Fourier inversion on R^n: ∑_b ψ_𝔪((x − a)·b) = |R^n|·[x = a], since ψ_𝔪 is primitive (`sum_addChar_dotProduct`, `isPrimitive_primAddChar`); this proves the identity of step 1.
